description: This file defines React components for pagination UI, including navigation, content, items, links, and controls like previous/next buttons and ellipsis indicator.

methods.name: Pagination
methods.description: Main pagination navigation component rendering a <nav> element with accessibility attributes.

methods.name: PaginationContent
methods.description: Component that renders the container <ul> for pagination items with styling.

methods.name: PaginationItem
methods.description: Component that renders a <li> element for individual pagination items.

methods.name: PaginationLink
methods.description: Component for a pagination link, styled as a button, with support for active state.

methods.name: PaginationPrevious
methods.description: Component for the 'Previous' page link with an icon and accessibility label.

methods.name: PaginationNext
methods.description: Component for the 'Next' page link with an icon and accessibility label.

methods.name: PaginationEllipsis
methods.description: Span component showing an ellipsis when pages are skipped.
